title: Update firmware from version 1.5
summary: Back up configuration, verify package integrity, install the maintenance release, and confirm recovery readiness.

sections.title: Perform a recoverable update
paragraphs: A configuration export is not a substitute for an operational rollback plan.

warning.condition: Power or network access is removed while the package is being committed.
warning.consequence: The controller can restart into recovery mode.
warning.avoidance: Use stable power, a local service connection, and an approved maintenance window.

steps: Export configuration and record the running version.
Verify the package SHA-256 digest against the release manifest.
Place controlled outputs in their documented safe state.
Install the package and wait for the health check to complete.
Verify configuration, I/O quality, and rollback availability.
